title: Professional 2026-09-20 — Ten inverter medium-voltage solar skid
goal: Show one ten-inverter skid within a larger solar project: dedicated incoming protection, low-voltage aggregation, a 0.8/33 kV transformer and medium-voltage protection. Project identity is removed.

rubric.must: All ten inverter branches are separately traceable through their individual breakers to the common low-voltage bus.
The aggregation, coupling breaker, step-up transformer and medium-voltage outlet form an identifiable power path.
Protection and telemetry connections remain distinguishable from power conductors; long ratings and equipment labels do not hide branch connections.

provenance.notes: Selected against a real first user request. Source defects are intentionally preserved. Project identity is removed; no customer IDs or private prompt text are included. These are evaluation inputs, not approved professional reference designs. Full conversation changes and domain behavior require separate review.
